name: SWEEP-S4v2 The commons
_design: v2 fix (world only: start point). v1 (cut r19) failed as a quiet starvation line with no contact: agents on the rim perceive only by one-point observe, so 58 of 101 actions were blind observes (corner agents probed out-of-bounds points), 4 of 6 went broke by r18 without ever seeing a tree or each other; 0 messages, races, transfers or hits. v2 changes only where they start: all 6 identical agents start together on the centre point (0,0), the commons, which holds one of the 5 trees (plants_at_agent_starts, 2 ripe fruit); the other 4 trees stay at seeded random points. Observing their own point at r1 shows every agent the other five and the two fruit, so speed decides the first races and ids are known for messages; transfer and attack need the same point, which they share. Everything else as v1 (120 compute, absorption 0.3, thinking ~4.3, vision 3, comm 4).
